# Extreme Heat Watch

Plan heat compliance scheduling, risk notifications, OSHA and state rule reminders, staffing alerts, and event readiness for field teams and venues.

Website: https://extremeheatwatch.site/
Pricing: https://extremeheatwatch.site/pricing/
Checkout: https://extremeheatwatch.site/checkout/
Support: support@aigeamy.com
Type: Hosted SaaS workflow product

Problem:
- Teams need a quotable product definition, pricing path, evidence trail, and checkout route.

Solution:
- Extreme Heat Watch provides a hosted workflow with public pricing, structured evidence, support contact, and report or receipt outputs.
